main_text.l: Causa fuit socordia Merovingo-rum, qui, veluti Sardanapali, omnem regni curam in Majores Domus re-jiciebant, à quibus tandem regno plane spoliati sunt, tanquam indigni. Memorabile est, hos Merovingos se-mel tantum in anno, nimirum die Paschatis, corollâ florea redimitos populo conspiciendas se præbuisse in plaustro rustico, quod ad majo-rem contemtum boves trahebant.

Pipinus igitur, cognomine Par-vus, consensu Zachariæ Pontificis Romani Chilpericum stupidum, ultimum ex familia Merovingorum, in Monasterium detrusit, & se Regem Franciæ constituit. Ejus filius fuit Carolus Magnus.

page.notes: The "Sub" at the lower right is the catchword. The marginal note's hyphenation ("fa-miliæ", "Gal-lia") is inferred from the line breaks. "Chilpericum" is copied as printed (the usual form is Childericum). The page number is printed as "45" in the running head.
